subject: Executive demo — global clockshift coordination
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@helixhealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec demo — aligning across US / EU / APAC

Hi Michael / Sofia — thanks for the note and for being flexible. We want to make sure your leadership (US-based CEO, EU Head of Engineering, and APAC CTO) can all join live if possible — or at least that two execs attend and the third joins a short handoff. A couple constraints to flag up front: US DST flips on Mar 12 this year which will temporarily change overlap windows with EU, and EU DST follows later in March.

Attached is a short availability matrix (timezone-availability-matrix.xlsx) that maps the execs' windows to a three-region grid. Suggested options that balance travel and reasonable waking hours:

- Option A (single full exec session): Tue Mar 21, 09:00 PT / 18:00 CET / Wed Mar 22, 01:00 SGT — OK if APAC can join late-night.
- Option B (split handoff): Tue Mar 21, 08:30 PT / 17:30 CET — US+EU deep-dive (45m), followed by a short recorded recap for APAC + 1:00 SGT async Q&A + optional 15m live APAC sync at 08:00 SGT next day.
- Option C (staggered exec slots): EU exec joins at 17:00 CET for a 30m slot, US exec at 09:00 PT for a 30m slot, and we stitch the two with a 10-minute crosswalk; this reduces one long cross-region call.

Please confirm which approach would work best for Helix leadership. If none of the above are possible I can propose a handful of alternate days the week of Mar 28 that are slightly more APAC-friendly (but conflict with some Redwood field exec travel).

If useful I can also send a Calendly/ICS with the three options; Marcus will run run-of-show with product and Karthik will join for technical deep-dive on inference latency and security (SOC2 notes attached in the Drive link).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pre-demo-agenda.pdf, timezone-availability-matrix.xlsx

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@helixhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 21:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Exec demo — aligning across US / EU / APAC

Thanks Kimberly — this is helpful. Quick context from our side:
- Our CEO (US, Pacific) prefers mornings PT.
- Head of Engineering (EU, Amsterdam) prefers 16:30—18:30 CET.
- CTO (APAC, Singapore) is usually available after 19:00 SGT but prefers not to be earlier than 22:00 SGT unless it's a short (<=30m) exec call.

Given that, Option B (split handoff) looks most realistic. Can we do: Tue Mar 21 08:30 PT / 17:30 CET for the live US+EU session (45m) and record a 12–15 minute executive highlight tailored for APAC with a 15m live Q&A at 22:15 SGT the same day? That keeps it late but shorter for the CTO.

Two asks: 1) can you share a 10-minute pre-read slide deck before the session? 2) we need an ICS invite that clearly shows local times for each participant and notes the DST caveat.

-Michael
Michael Chen
Director, Platform Partnerships | Helix Health
michael.chen@helixhealth.com | +44 20 7946 03xx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@helixhealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 01:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec demo — aligning across US / EU / APAC

Agreed with Michael — split handoff looks best. A couple operational notes from our side:
- We should keep the live demo (US+EU) tightly scripted to 40–45 minutes: 15m exec intro, 20m product demo (focus on latency & privacy controls), 5–10m Q&A. Karthik will cover the latency numbers and fallback policies.
- For APAC, instead of a second live full demo, let's pre-record a 12-minute 1:1 exec highlight that calls out cost/latency tradeoffs and include a short live sync (15m) at 22:15 SGT for AMA. We'll post the pre-recorded clip in the calendar invite and a Drive link.
- I can create two back-to-back calendar invites: 'Helix — Exec Demo (US/EU)' and 'Helix — APAC exec highlight + Q&A'. Both invites will include local-time strings and an explicit note: "Note: US DST begins Mar 12 — ensure local times update if your calendar adjusts automatically."

I'll attach a proposed run-of-show in Drive (proposed-run-of-show.docx) and drop a short agenda PDF. Kimberly — want me to own the calendar invites?

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@helixhealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec demo — aligning across US / EU / APAC

Perfect — thank you both. Marcus, please go ahead and create the two invites. Michael / Sofia, next steps from Redwood:
1) I will send a 10-slide pre-read (attached as pre-demo-agenda.pdf) before EOD Fri Mar 16.
2) Marcus will send the ICS invites and Drive links by EOD Fri Mar 16.
3) Karthik will prepare a short latency/security appendix we can attach for the Head of Engineering.

Please confirm the two calendar blocks work for Helix:
- Helix — Exec Demo (US/EU): Tue Mar 21, 08:30 PT / 17:30 CET — duration 45m
- Helix — APAC exec highlight + Q&A: Tue Mar 21, 22:15 SGT — duration 15m

If I don't hear objections by Fri morning we'll lock and send invites. Note: the Mar 21 dates are pre-DST in EU so times are as listed above; if either side auto-adjusts after Mar 12, Marcus will double-check local-time rendering.

Thanks — Kim

Attachments referenced: pre-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@helixhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Thanks Kim — that plan works for us. A couple small items: please include a short call-out in the calendar invite about whether the event is "recorded" and where the recording will live; also please add a DocuSign link for the demo NDA we sent earlier (DocuSign: https://docusign.com/HLX-NDA-1297). Sofia will confirm final attendee list by Mon Mar 13.

Appreciate the coordination — looking forward to it.

-Michael

--
Michael Chen
Director, Platform Partnerships | Helix Health
notes: Calendar invites to be created by Marcus. Pre-read due EOD Mar 16. APAC live Q&A short to respect CTO availability. DST caveat called out in invites.
